blogPosts.title: Orbit Marketing Without Any AI API Key
blogPosts.metaDescription: Run Orbit SEO and launch copy without EasyPeasy, OpenAI, or Gemini. Built-in templates plus Cursor Cloud Agent ingest — zero new API keys.
blogPosts.content:
You do not need another AI API key to run Orbit.

## Three ways Orbit writes content

1. **Built-in templates** — SEO pages, social packs, and outreach copy generate instantly with zero configuration.
2. **Cursor Cloud Agent** — the AI model in your agent session writes researched articles and ingests them straight into your site.
3. **Optional API keys** — Gemini or OpenAI only if you want richer copy on the live button press.

## When EasyPeasy stops working

Word limits and connection errors are common on gateway accounts. Orbit no longer blocks your run. It falls back to templates automatically, or you can ask a Cloud Agent to write and publish content using `/api/orbit/ingest-content`.

## How the agent path works

From this repo:

```bash
cd Svivva
node scripts/orbit.mjs ingest scripts/orbit-agent-content.json
```

The agent uses its own model to draft posts, saves JSON, and the CLI publishes plus pings IndexNow. No keys pasted in Vercel.

## What still runs without AI

Google Search Console indexing, IndexNow, sitemap submission, Stripe checks, and template-based page generation all work with no AI billing at all.

## Start now

Press **urrthang** for templates and indexing. For premium copy, run a Cloud Agent task to ingest fresh blog and SEO pages — like this article.
